description: This file defines a React component for a Document Editor demo, including configuration UI, rendering, and integration of various document features using Keystone 6 and Emotion styling.

methods.name: documentFeaturesCodeExample
methods.description: Generates a code example string of the document feature configuration in Keystone syntax based on the current config.

methods.name: documentFeaturesToShorthand
methods.description: Converts a DocumentFeatures object to a shorthand configuration object for UI.

methods.name: objToShorthand
methods.description: Helper that condenses an object with uniform values into a simplified form.

methods.name: boolToTrueOrUndefined
methods.description: Converts a boolean to true or undefined for shorthand config.

methods.name: documentFeaturesFormToValue
methods.description: Transforms form state into a DocumentFeatures object.
